summary: Iteration 3 tested only the new features. Voice notes were not tested, as instructed. Backend: 16/16 pytest pass. PATCH /api/partner/listings/{id} handles owner-only access (404 for another agent or an unknown id), rejects price 0, -5 or 'abc' with 422, returns 400 for images [], stores price as an int, sets image=images[0] and image_count, and pushes price_history only when the price changes. GET /api/partner/summary returns the agent, seller and fixa blocks with 7-day series. homes_sold goes up by 1 after a listing is marked sold. offers_received, offers_won and money_won go up after an offer and its acceptance. The buyer gets no agent or fixa block. Frontend (390x844): the This week card shows the hero metric, 2 small metrics, 7 bars and the Listen button for agent (adaeze), seller and FIXA (after the role switch). It is not shown for brand. On listing detail, Share on WhatsApp calls GET /api/share/property/{id} (200) and opens a wa.me popup containing the listing text. The WhatsApp circle on Work>Homes cards works and does not also open the card. Edit screen: price is prefilled, the -10/-5/+5/+10% buttons and typed input update the price and the old -> new line, photo X removes photos, Save is disabled with 0 photos and shows a hint, and Save sends the PATCH (200) and returns to detail with the new price, which was checked in the DB. No deprecated Expo packages were detected.

minor.issue: price_history entry stores the raw body.price (float, e.g. 1800000.0) instead of the int-normalised changes['price']. Reference: backend/partner_app.py:142

The backend wa.me URL correctly encodes the emojis (💰 🏠 👉). WhatsApp's wa.me -> api.whatsapp.com redirect on web turns them into U+FFFD (�) in the prefilled text. This is a known WhatsApp redirect quirk. Consider using https://api.whatsapp.com/send?text= directly, or whatsapp://send on native.

issues: Photo remove X (edit-photos-remove-{i}) is 36x36, below the 44pt minimum touch target. This matters for low-literacy and older users.

Raise the photo remove X hit area to 44x44 or larger (src/photos.tsx), for example with hitSlop or a bigger size.
Optional: build the share link as api.whatsapp.com/send?text= so the emojis survive the redirect.
critical_code_review_comments: edit/[id].tsx:35 runs absUrl() on the existing images, and Save sends them back. Any relative '/api/...' image path gets rewritten into an absolute URL on the current backend host (the preview domain). Those links break after deploy or a host change. Keep the original paths for display-only absUrl and send the raw values in the PATCH.
Summary: homes_sold relies on status_changed_at. Listings sold through other paths that don't set status_changed_at (legacy or admin) are not counted. admin_portal does set it, so this is acceptable.
Edit screen: a non-owner can open /listing/edit/{id} because GET /properties/{id} is public. Save then returns 404 'Listing not found' as a toast. This is handled correctly.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (week card x4 roles, share x2 entry points, edit price/photos/save)
